result.detail:
Open items against the plan in microarchitecture section 6:
(1) No apb_regs_tb_fail.v. The platform compiles every testbench file and takes its top from the first one, so a second, deliberately failing testbench could confuse the simulator.run input. It belongs in its own task.
(2) No apb_regs.sby. The task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench only, and the formal gate applies only if a formal_spec is submitted. The interface spec does require an unbounded proof, so a follow-on task should submit one single-task, mode-prove .sby that lists apb_regs.v.

Deliberate choice: the APB knowledge document mentions a property set that expects PREADY low during reset [FAPB]. The approved specs instead say pready is high in reset and is tied high, and the RTL follows the specs.

Neither file uses `timescale, which avoids Verilator's TIMESCALEMOD error.

The testbench restates the decode as a < 0x10 and builds the strobe merge from a byte mask, independently of the RTL. I have not run any tool.
